name_input: JR ONE KOTHARI FOOTWEAR PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/jr-one-kothari-footwear-private-limited) shows the company as shipper on outbound lanes: "2026-02-27 JR ONE KOTHARI FOOTWEAR PRIVATE LIMITED BD INTERNATIONAL GROUP LTD, FOOTWEAR - CROCBAND BLK SKU 11016-001 LOT CODE 2026RV03T376- CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India Malta Valetta, MALTA 64029990 1083273" and "2026-02-27 JR ONE KOTHARI FOOTWEAR PRIVATE LIMITED CROCS JAPAN GK FOOTWEAR - BAYA II SLIDE WHI -SKU208215-100 LOT CODE-2026RV02T624- CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India Tokyo, JAPAN 64029990 1099514". Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 36246 Records detected", "Trading Partners 101", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; only 5 individual shipment rows are rendered in the free view (rows actually seen = 5 of 36,246 claimed). Outbound destinations visible in the buyer block: CROCS EUROPE BV (Rotterdam, NETHERLANDS, 7064 shipments), CROCS INC (Broomfield USA, 693), CROCS KOREA INC (Busan, SOUTH KOREA, 205), APPAREL TRADING COMPANY LIMITED (Riyadh, SAUDI ARABIA, 2424). Port lanes include "Rotterdam 2200" and "Ho Chi Minh VICT 3993", consistent with two-way trade.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record was retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403 and web_search (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable ("Connection refused") during this run, so no domestic-supply record could be read. Indirect only: the same customs page shows inbound raw-material imports addressed to the Chennai factory, e.g. "2026-02-28 BEST TREND TRADING LIMITED- JR ONE KOTHARI FOOTWEAR PRIVATE LIMITED XC228 SELF-COLORED DISPERSANT ADDITIVE 898[N/A] (COMPOUNDS FOR FOOTWEAR MANUFACTURING UNIT)" HS 38249900 BOL 7812432 and "PK52 EVA TAISOX 7470M ... (COMPOUNDS FOR FOOTWEAR MANUFACTURING UNIT)" HS 39013000 BOL 7813395 — i.e. manufacturing inputs, not proof of domestic sales.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data (registered address 114, Nungambakkam High Road, Nungambakkam, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600034). Role: manufacturer (imports footwear compounds/EVA for its own unit) and re-exporter of Crocs-branded footwear; also appears as importer of finished Crocs product from Malta/Japan/Vietnam — so manufacturer_trader is the fairer label. HS correction: declared 640299;640399 is only partly right — actual observed codes are 64029990 (footwear, outbound) plus 38249900 and 39013000 (chemical/EVA inputs, inbound); the 640399 line is not evidenced in the visible rows. Industry claim "Продукты питания и FMCG" is wrong — this is footwear. Export side is confirmed by dated customs rows with B/L numbers (1083273, 1099514) and named destinations (Malta, Japan; buyer blocks show Netherlands, USA, South Korea, Saudi Arabia). Domestic side: no GST/tender/contract evidence obtained — treat as declared_only, not confirmed; absence here is a research gap (blocked sources), not a finding of no domestic supply. Revenue and export volume: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts (36,246 total records) but no value figures, and no annual report was accessible. No sanctions/court issues checked in this run (out of scope for this role).
